payload.title: The red_first_* gate blockers are never classified by the delivery settlement: implementation_rejections names only validation_regression, suppression_pattern and candidate_validation_not_green, so every red_first outcome settles unclassified and a proven suite regression that arrives with a red_first blocker loses its request-fault attribution
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/apply_engine.py:280-289 (the red_first blockers are appended to the gate's own blocked_by)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/apply_engine.py:931-937 (RED_FIRST_BLOCKERS is declared and referenced by no production code)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_rejections.py:145-146 (the agent-fault blocker sets name three blockers and no red_first_*)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_rejections.py:175-177 (a gate_blocked reason is the agent's only when every item is in AGENT_GATE_BLOCKERS)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_grounding.py:136-151 (an unclassified ending counts toward a streak of two before the subject cools off)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per concept (CLAUDE.md single-center rule, F3.5a spec item 3): the gate's blocker vocabulary and the settlement's fault vocabulary must agree by construction, or a test must pin each name's class (tier 3).
payload.notes: A finding-origin delivery whose suite regresses and whose agent declared no red-first test is blocked with blocked_by validation_regression,red_first_declaration_missing. _gate_blockers_are_the_agents needs every item inside AGENT_GATE_BLOCKERS, so the settlement is unclassified instead of request, and finding_grounding counts it as an unverified ending (a streak of two before cool-off) rather than a failure. Every red_first verdict, including a refuted pin that is provably the agent's, settles the same way, and no test names the intended class for any of them. Close condition: Decide each RED_FIRST_BLOCKERS name in implementation_rejections (agent-proving or not), taking the names from the apply_engine tuple instead of retyping them, make the verifier treat a proving blocker as proving when a decided non-agent blocker accompanies it, and add a test over every RED_FIRST_BLOCKERS name asserting its settlement class. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
